caption: The level of detail in this futuristic cyberpunk metropolis is truly staggering, from the multi-layered vertical gardens to the cramped neon-lit alleys. Every tiny building tells a story of a city that never sleeps. Also, if you look closely at the street corner, there's one tiny resident who seems quite grumpy about being relocated.
